people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Ephron
people.line: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Machpelah
people.line: A cave near Hebron; burial place of patriarchs

people.name: Mamre
people.line: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham

translations.web: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
translations.bsb: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, in the land of Canaan. This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
translations.kjv: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
translations.asv: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a burying-place.
